title: TSV copy changes cell values and structure
reproduction: Extract rows with tab/newline/quote characters in cells and field names.
Copy TSV and parse/paste as spreadsheet; compare exact values and dimensions.
expected: Spreadsheet copy preserves field names, cell values and dimensions.
actual: rowsToTsv replaces tabs/newlines in values with spaces and emits rawunescapedheaders, changing values or columns.
severity: S2: copied extraction data loses original content.
verification_status: Source-proven formatter behavior; no nativeclipboard proof. Source-only fix assigned while resourceguard refusesruntime.
